THE ADVERTISE PURPLE DIFFERENCE

Why Choose an Award-Winning Affiliate Management Agency

When businesses join Advertise Purple, they see remarkable improvement to their affiliate programs as early as month one. Our results compound over time, starting with our proven 90-day ramp-up strategy.

Performance-based alignment - we only win when you win

Direct relationships with 300,000+ top-producing publishers

Exclusive access to proprietary recruiting & audit software

Dedicated account team with vertical-specific expertise

How Our Affiliate Management Process Works

Every client engagement follows a structured path built to move fast without cutting corners.


1

Program Audit and Strategy

We start by auditing your current affiliate presence, competitors, and commission structure, then build a growth roadmap tailored to your vertical.


2

Affiliate Recruitment and Activation

Our recruitment team identifies affiliates who already reach your target customers, then handles outreach, negotiation, and onboarding.


3

Active Optimization

Once your program launches, we monitor performance daily, test new creative and offers, and adjust commission tiers to keep growth moving.

4

Reporting and Continuous Growth

Through Bloom, you get real-time visibility into results while our team keeps recruiting new partners to expand your reach.

Exclusive Industry Access with Performance Marketing Specialists

As pioneers of tech-enabled, outsourced program management (OPM), we leverage data to build predictive growth models and ensure positive outcomes for our clients.

Our agency is organized as an innovative departmental ecosystem that works harmoniously to achieve your brand's objectives.

In-House vs. Affiliate Agency: Side-by-Side Comparison

Brands often ask whether to build an affiliate program internally or bring in a dedicated agency. Here is how the two approaches compare.

Program Audit and Strategy

Requires hiring, training, and retaining specialized affiliate marketing staff

Limited to whatever affiliate network and relationships your team has already built

Slower to test new strategies without dedicated tools or benchmarking data

Partnering with Advertise Purple

Gives you an experienced team from day one, without hiring overhead

Opens access to a network of affiliates built over more than a decade

Opens access to a network of affiliates built over more than a decade

Bloom by Advertise Purple - Affiliate Program Intelligence Backed by Technology

Bloom offers unparalleled insight and transparency into your affiliate program. With its user-friendly interface, you can track strategies and analyses in real time, ensuring you're always informed and confident in our efforts.

Technological Transparency

Original: We emphasize technological transparency by offering clients comprehensive data visibility and advanced analytics through our proprietary platform, enabling real-time performance monitoring and informed decision-making.

We emphasize technological transparency by offering clients comprehensive data visibility and advanced analytics through our proprietary platform, enabling real-time performance monitoring and informed decision-making.

Real-Time Insights from an Experienced Affiliate Management Team

Shoppers can access real-time program visibility through Bloom, backed by Advertise Purple's experienced affiliate management team. Track performance, understand the strategies driving your program, and stay informed as your team identifies opportunities and optimizes performance throughout the affiliate program lifecycle.

A Trusted Team

What is Bloom without the people behind it? Advertise Purple combines proprietary technology with a dedicated team of affiliate marketing experts who actively manage and optimize your program. With transparent reporting, established affiliate relationships, and hands-on support, your team provides the expertise and visibility needed to make informed decisions with confidence.

Leverage Data & Tech for Unparalleled Brand Growth

Bloom, our award-winning client business intelligence dashboard, redefines how agencies and clients communicate. With trust and transparency as our ethos, Bloom provides real-time strategy and analysis, displaying the details of our involvement down to the hour.

Connect with our team today.

Vertical
Benchmarking

Vertical benchmarking allows brands to evaluate their performance relative to industry standards in 23 verticals, offering critical insights into their competitive standing for core metrics.

Advanced Opportunity Pairing

We source affiliates through Bloom's data-driven matching engine, established publisher relationships, and direct outreach to partners already active in your space.

Advanced Opportunity Pairing

Advanced algorithms in Bloom have systematically matched our brands with over 228,000 compatible growth strategies, leading to 10X Agency of the Year Finalist nominations and driving over $4.5 billion in sales.

Performance-Based Billing

Advanced algorithms in Bloom have systematically matched our brands with over 228,000 compatible growth strategies, leading to 10X Agency of the Year Finalist nominations and driving over $4.5 billion in sales.

Future
Proofing

The integration of advanced tools ensures optimal performance, strategic enhancements, and sustained positive returns on investment, positioning brands for long-term success in a competitive landscape.

International Reach with Dedicated Teams

With dedicated teams worldwide, our global reach and expertise have driven over $1.1B in affiliate sales for international brands. Our comprehensive approach ensures your brand's success across multiple markets.

Unmatched Client Count, Unrivaled Results

Our commitment to excellence has earned us industry-wide recognition and a track record of success. We are proud to be the number one choice for affiliate program management.

Industry-Acclaimed Client Satisfaction

Our clients consistently report high satisfaction levels, thanks to our innovative strategies, dedicated support, and transparent communication. We are committed to maintaining and exceeding these standards.

How Performance-Based Billing Works

Our billing model is designed so our team only grows when your affiliate program does.

Commission-Aligned Fees

A portion of our compensation is tied to affiliate-driven sales, so our incentives stay aligned with your results.

Performance-Driven Growth

We build and optimize affiliate programs that connect your brand with the right partners and turn those relationships into measurable revenue.

Transparent Cost Tracking

Bloom shows exactly how billing is calculated each month, so there are no surprises on your invoice.

Why Advertise Purple Is Your Award-Winning Affiliate Partner

Frequently Asked Questions

01

What makes Advertise Purple different from other affiliate marketing agencies?

Our track record of Inc. 5000 recognition, in-house technology like Bloom, and dedicated departmental teams set us apart from agencies that treat affiliate management as a side service rather than a core specialty.

02

What does an affiliate marketing management agency actually do day-to-day?

Day-to-day work includes recruiting and vetting affiliates, negotiating commissions, monitoring performance, testing creative, resolving compliance issues, and reporting results back to your team.

03

How do you find and recruit affiliates or influencers to promote our brand?

We combine Bloom's matching technology with established publisher relationships and direct outreach to identify affiliates whose audience and content already align with your brand.

04

Do you offer exclusive access to affiliates and publishers we couldn't reach on our own?

Yes. Our relationships with top-performing affiliates, built over more than a decade, give clients access to partners who are difficult to reach without an established agency behind you.

05

What technology or tools do you use to manage affiliate programs?

Bloom, our proprietary business intelligence dashboard, gives you real-time visibility into affiliate performance, vertical benchmarking, and program activity down to the hour.

06

How is affiliate commission structured, and who decides the payout rates?

Commission structures are built collaboratively based on your margins, vertical benchmarks, and growth goals, then adjusted over time as we learn what motivates your top affiliates.

07

How do you prevent affiliate fraud or fake conversions from draining our budget?

Every affiliate is vetted before approval, and ongoing monitoring flags unusual traffic or conversion patterns so fraudulent activity is caught and addressed quickly.

08

How long does it typically take to see results after launching an affiliate program with you?

Many clients see measurable improvement as early as month one, with momentum building steadily as new affiliates are recruited and optimized.

09

What's the difference between hiring an affiliate agency versus managing the program in-house?

An agency brings an established team, affiliate network, and technology from day one, while managing in-house means building all three from scratch.

10

How do you track and attribute sales back to the correct affiliate?

Bloom tracks every click and conversion back to its source affiliate, giving you accurate attribution and full visibility into which partners are driving results.

11

Do you help launch a brand-new affiliate program, or only manage existing ones?

We do both. Our team builds new programs from the ground up and also takes over and optimizes affiliate programs that are already running.

12

How do you vet affiliates to make sure they align with our brand?

We review each affiliate's audience, content, and compliance history before approval, ensuring every partner promoting your brand fits its values and standards.

13

What ongoing reporting do we get to see how our affiliate program is performing?

Through Bloom, you receive real-time strategy and analysis, with reporting detailed enough to show program activity and results down to the hour.
